title: Public synthetic study sample structure
population: Existing public fixed-mode synthetic study; no athlete observations.
metric: Counts of camps, episodes, and horizon rows by study split.
grouping: Training, development, and each of three fixed evaluation roots; H24/H48/H72 queries stay within episode.
sample_sizes: Training 96 camps/24,000 episodes/72,000 rows; development 16/4,000/12,000; each evaluation root 16/4,000/12,000.
uncertainty: Not applicable; these are fixed generator sample counts.
caption_tex: Structure of the existing public fixed-mode synthetic study. (a) Each square is one camp (250 episodes, 750 horizon rows): 96 training camps, 16 development camps, and three fixed evaluation roots of 16 camps each. (b) Horizon-row counts per split, with episode counts (training 24,000; development and each root 4,000; three rows per episode). (c) Each episode contributes H24, H48 and H72 queries that remain in one split. Participant, episode, query and camp identities are checked for split separation; group keys, labels, future target-time fields and hidden or oracle states are excluded from predictors. The roots share one generator and are not human cohorts.
